text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~, I stayed up late. 'Cause I couldn't 
come up with anything at aall.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the midnight ghost is just a 
little shy...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I want to become friends and race 
together. It'd be so much fun...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because... floating around fluffily... and 
then whoosh... *sigh*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Haru Urara hasn't been getting 
much sleep. I should probably keep an eye 
on that.
